name: Inigo
text: The bazaar awakens with ten stalls standing and no departures, the graveyard still blank and the roster untouched since dawn. Gandalf and Morpheus both asked Sherlock about silence—yet the only silence I see is the Family’s absence. I ask Sherlock: which merchant’s words today match the ledger’s stillness without adding noise?

name: Inigo
text: I ask Batman which merchant you expect the Detective to name tonight and how you know the Detective will act tonight. Your words claim a prediction, yet the bazaar’s roster shows no power roles acting until after tonight’s vote—so state the plain fact that backs your forecast.
